note_subsampling: Sec7 per-frame metrics (H-bonds, pi-stacking, group contacts, water shell) subsampled to 1 frame/ns across 50-100ns (50 frames) for compute budget; documented simplification, not full-frame statistics.

hbonds.criterion: D-A<=0.35nm heavy-heavy (approx via H position for water in D-H...A geometry), D-H...A angle>=150deg
hbonds.cyclic_acid_dimer_occupancy_pct: n/a (no carboxylic-acid donor in this species)

pi_stacking.judgment_call: Ring definition simplified to a single best-fit plane through the WHOLE fused polyaromatic core per molecule (SVD normal), not individual 5-/6-membered sub-rings; stacking = centroid-centroid <=0.6nm AND interplanar angle<=30deg. This detects overall face-to-face stacking of the flat scaffold but cannot resolve which sub-ring mediates a given contact.

group_contact_map.criterion: atom-atom <0.45nm, intermolecular only, mean over sampled window frames
group_contact_map.note: alkyl group not separately defined -- scaffold is fully (hetero)aromatic/fused-ring with no distinct aliphatic chain besides the ester methyl (included in BE7 headgroup); judgment call documented.

water_first_shell.criterion: water O within 0.35nm of any solute heavy atom, divided by N molecules

water_diffusion_simplified.method: SIMPLIFIED single-time-origin (not multi-origin, not full nojump-unwrapped) MSD over one 200 ps lag at t=75.0 ns, minimum-image displacement (adequate for this short lag since PBC re-crossing within 200ps is rare for water) -- reported as a simplified estimate per task instructions, not a rigorous multi-origin water diffusion analysis.
